attachmentExcerpt.text: CO/SEC/4(7)/2026-27/ BSE & NSE Filing/39 2nd October, 2026 BSE Limited Listing Department Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400 001 National Stock Exchange of India Ltd Listing Department Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor, Plot No C/1, G Block, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400051 Sub: Signing of an agreement for acquiring 50% stake of CAE Canada in HATSOFF Helicopter Training Pvt. Ltd. Ref: BSE Scrip Code: 541154, NSE Symbol: HAL *** In terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that, the Company has entered into an agreement for acquisition of 50% stake in HATSOFF Helicopter Training Pvt. Ltd i.e., 3,84,04,205 (Three Crore Eighty-Four Lakh Four Thousand Two Hundred Five) equity shares each with a face value of Rs 10/- (Rs Ten only) from M/s CAE, Canada, at NIL consideration. 2. Upon transfer of the above referred shares, the HATSOFF Helicopter Training Pvt. Ltd. will become 100% Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of HAL. 3. Other details required to be disclosed are as follows: SI No. Particulars Details 1. Name of the target entity, details in brief such as size, turnover etc HATSOFF Helicopter Training Pvt Ltd (HATSOFF). HATSOFF is operating as a 50:50 Joint Venture between Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) and M/s CAE, Canada to impart military and civil Helicopter pilot training through operation of simulators. Authorized Capital: ₹ 76.84 Crs Paid-up capital: ₹ 76.80 Crs Turnover FY 2025-26: ₹ 80.95 Crs
